change: six sthalas mapped onto the SSM's 101-sthala scheme
reason: the SSM itself subdivides each of the six (5.27–30; 10.4–6; 11.3–5; 12.4–5; 13.3–4; 14.3) and adds 57 liṅga-sthalas resting on them (15.1–3)

change: three liṅgas correlated with the gross, subtle and causal bodies
reason: correlation of the vacana and manual tradition (low confidence on its textual source); SSM 6.49–50 grades the liṅgas gross/subtle/beyond, which supports only the first two members directly

change: SSM 10.40 (master–servant requires difference) and 14.9/14.37 (pati and paśu imagined; no 'I am servant') read as stage-assigned teachings
reason: the text states its teaching is sixfold by sthala and adhikārin (5.22–23) and places the two statements in the māheśvara and aikya sthalas respectively

change: SSM 10.48–52 (earth etc. neither non-different from Śiva nor separate; Maheśa is not the clay) and 10.63–70 (the world is Śiva-made and non-different from him) read as successive sub-stages of the māheśvara-sthala
reason: the text places them in the aṣṭamūrtinirasana and śivajaganmaya sub-sthalas in order (10.4–6) and frames the path by stage (5.22–23)

change: prasādi and first three prāṇaliṅgi sub-sthalas (25–34) → band B4
reason: serenity of mind, inner worship and śivayoga-samādhi — absorption with support
direct experience of the inner liṅga as one's own form — first seeing
deepening in bridal union, removal of tamas, the guru's pointing-out and steadiness — cultivation after seeing
union and non-duality — final liberation
the conduct of the liberated, every act worship — activity after liberation

change: partially reconciled within the SSM under P4
reason: the SSM itself upholds Veda–Āgama authority (5.3–14) while placing liṅga-worship above sacrifice for its adhikārins (15.30–36; 9.39–40) and grades its teaching by sthala (5.22–23)
the SSM places commensality rules in the bhakta-sthala and equal vision in the aikya-sthala, and grades its teaching by sthala and adhikārin (5.22–23)

change: outer and inner liṅga-worship graded by stage within the SSM
reason: SSM 6.48 enjoins the outer liṅga for all and 15.44 assigns ritual worship to those of little understanding and inner worship to knowers

change: partially reconciled under P4 and P2
